new_value: Root cause of the 6 red suites: lichen_schc_compress capped RAW input at SCHC_FRAGMENT_MAX_PACKET_SIZE (22554), but compressible packets legitimately have raw > compressed - the rule1-6 profile-limit tests build raw up to MAX+15 expecting encoded output == MAX (Rust has no raw-input cap; the ceiling applies to the ENCODED SCHC packet, codec.rs:1123). Fix: removed the raw-input cap; enforced the ceiling on encoded output instead - fallback branches (pre-IPv6 in the wrapper, version-6 generic dispatcher in subsys/schc/schc.c, mirroring Rust encode_rule255 needed > profile_limit) and the rule compressors' own existing caps. rule5/6 also pinned a stale error code (INVALID_ARGUMENT) for the corrupt-checksum case; updated to the committed gate contract NO_MATCHING_RULE (rule1's agnostic <0 and Python/Rust rejection semantics unchanged; atomicity assertions retained). New pin: tests/schc test_rule255_fallback_profile_ceiling (raw 22553 -> 22554 OK; 22554 -> BUFFER_TOO_SMALL, atomic) - the exact C/Rust divergence the review probe found. Verified on heft: all 18 C host suites green (clang+ASan/UBSan; schc 16/16 incl. new test), cppcheck clean. 3x codereview (correctness/security/robustness, reviewer-model passes): converged on the generic-dispatcher fallback ceiling gap, fixed in this commit; resource-exhaustion/int-overflow/remote-DoS re-checks all PASS (u16 declared lengths bound IPv6 input at 65575, INT_MAX guard retained, no VLAs, all writes out_len-bounded); pre-existing finding filed as 1dft (C generic decompress RX ceiling).
